The ever-reliable Yui bolts as soon as the vase shatters leaving our protagonist, Jun, responsible for helping Uesugi Kenshin and Takeda Shingen adapt to modern Japan. Experience a wild ride alongside Jun and the commander babes as they unravel the secrets of modern mathematics, the English language, and the art of babymaking!
